headline: The vice chair of the government's new Super Intelligence Force argued on Fox News that slowing down the AI race could help America's adversaries.
score_reason: Pool 5 kept: an official's stated view on the pace of US AI work, but only a short programme description is available, with no detail of his remarks.
importance_line: A senior official of the new government AI body arguing against slowing down matters first to the public and lawmakers debating how fast AI should advance, then to AI companies; it is one official's view, and the short programme item gives neither his exact words nor his evidence.
summary: Fox News reports that Scott Kupor, vice chair of the Super Intelligence Force, the White House AI task force announced on 4 Oct 2026, argued on its programme 'Saturday in America' that slowing down in the AI race could benefit the United States' adversaries.
notes: Fox News video page; only the programme description was available. Task force background from our 5 Oct 2026 edition.
